declaredIntent.summary: Replace the positive-only WIII governance permission list with a stable local structured decision projection for external Agent consumption.

problemStatement: WIII V2 exposes governancePermissions only as a positive list derived from legacy actionEligibility. An external Agent cannot determine denied phases, the blocking reasons, the conditions, the projection version, or the evidence basis, and therefore cannot make a stable evidence-based scheduling decision.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A blocked implementation, finish, or closure phase reports allowed=false with stable reason codes and supporting condition/evidence fields.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Focused V2 tests assert all governed phases, including denied phases, expose structured decisions without retry or cancel instructions.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a focused failing test before implementation, then run the focused WIII suite and full required quality checks.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An eligible verification phase reports allowed=true while retaining status version and basis metadata.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Focused V2 tests assert an allowed phase has an empty denial reason list and explains its observed eligibility basis.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise a fact sequence with verification eligible and inspect the explicit V2 snapshot.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: V1 remains an explicit compatibility view and no scheduler, retry, cancellation, network, credential, or external authority behavior is added.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Existing and new tests preserve V1 output selection and prove retry/cancel are absent from the structured V2 governance permission contract.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the WIII focused and full tests plus Contract-required quality verification.

riskAssessment.reason: The public local WIII V2 projection and schema change together; a malformed compatibility or denial explanation could mislead an external Agent, but no authority or remote behavior is introduced.

reasons: Public schema, local interface, test, and generated truth-document changes require the standard repository profile.

executionDecision.reason: The owner authorized the WIII V2 remediation, sources define a bounded local projection, and all behavior can be verified locally and by hosted PR checks.

preReviewWarnings: Review stable machine-readable reason codes, the basis/condition fields, V1 compatibility, generated truth artifacts, and the absence of scheduler or authority behavior.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: V2 governancePermissions is a structured object covering implementation, verification, finish, and closure; each phase explicitly reports allowed state, stable reason codes, applicable conditions, status version, and evidence basis.
The object reports denied as well as allowed phases and never becomes an Agent scheduler, retry/cancel instruction, remote query, credential, or authority grant.
The snapshot schema, unit tests, and interface documentation agree on the V2 object; explicit V1 selection remains compatible.
Affected generated WIII truth and alignment evidence is regenerated from current behavior and all Contract-required checks pass.
guidelines: New public interface fields must be documented with their evidence and authority boundary.
Keep WIII repository-local and read-only; do not add scheduler, retry, cancellation, workflow-engine, agent-manager, remote transport, credential, or provider-authority behavior.
Maintain explicit V1 compatibility and do not treat derived cache or reports as authoritative evidence.

intent.problem: External Agents need a stable, evidence-bearing local WIII phase-decision projection instead of an ambiguous positive-only action list.
constraints: One Task remains one Work Item, branch, worktree, and PR; Agent/subagent scheduling stays outside WIII.
WIII remains worktree-local, repository-local, and read-only for this change.
No retry, cancellation, provider operation, network transport, sensitive material, or global active-work registry may be introduced.
V1 response mode remains explicit and compatible; V2 is additive and schema documented.
intent.rationale: A structured allowed/denied projection with reasons and evidence lets the Agent decide whether to call an atomic local operation while preserving calibrated human-agent trust and the Cockpit boundary.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The repository owner explicitly authorized completing all Work Items, including required Contract-recorded governance changes, PRs, merges, cleanup, audit repair loops, and release. This Work Item changes only the declared local WIII snapshot schema.
